meta.title: DSH Web Access
meta.description: Open this Harness instance in a local browser with its existing workspaces, sessions, and plugins.

settings.title: Web access settings
settings.unavailableAddress: The browser address is currently unavailable.
settings.autoLoginOn: Programs and devices that can reach this local port can sign in automatically.
settings.autoLoginOff: Select Open in browser to sign in from a new browser. Existing sessions stay signed in.
settings.openFailed: Couldn't open the browser. Try again.
settings.autoLoginSaveFailed: Couldn't save sign-in settings. Try again.
settings.portInUse: This port is in use. Choose another port.
settings.portSaveFailed: Couldn't apply the new port. Check the port setting.
settings.EADDRINUSE: The web port is in use. Choose another port and save.
settings.LISTEN_FAILED: Couldn't start web access. Check the port setting and save again.
settings.CONFIG_UNREADABLE: Couldn't read the saved web port. Save the port setting again.
settings.UNSUPPORTED_HOST: Web access requires a local Harness Host using HTTP.

authorization.title: Harness web authorization
authorization.heading: Sign in to Harness Web
authorization.instructions: In Harness Desktop, go to Plugins → DSH Web Access and select Open in browser.
